mechanism: slow session-level overreaction reverses next session
signal: standardized trailing session open-to-close return with extreme threshold
falsification_rule: Reject if frozen sealed Sharpe is below 2 or monthly hit rate below 70 percent

mechanism: upside and downside realized variation contain asymmetric information about momentum reversal
signal: trailing realized upside-minus-downside semivariance conditioned on recent direction
material_novelty: uses signed realized variation rather than total return alone
falsification_rule: Rejected after negative net expectancy and negative family Sharpe in chained outer folds

mechanism: early-session order flow predicts or reverses the closing window
signal: first 30 or 60 minute return conditioned on volume or volatility
target_horizon: last 30 to 120 minutes of the same session
material_novelty: nonoverlapping opening predictor and closing target with an intraday flat interval
falsification_rule: Rejected after negative net expectancy and negative family Sharpe in chained outer folds

mechanism: low realized range compression precedes directional expansion
signal: prior rolling range percentile plus current causal breakout
material_novelty: conditions breakout on compression state instead of price location alone
falsification_rule: Rejected after negative net expectancy and negative family Sharpe in chained outer folds

mechanism: economically linked futures transmit information with a lag
signal: lagged standardized return of a declared economic leader
material_novelty: uses fixed economic pairs and excludes unrelated peer averaging
falsification_rule: Rejected after negative zero-cost and costed walk-forward expectancy

mechanism: volume-confirmed price moves differ from low-participation moves
signal: return impulse interacted with causal volume surprise
material_novelty: interaction is the hypothesis rather than an entry filter
falsification_rule: Rejected after negative zero-cost and costed walk-forward expectancy

mechanism: closeness to a prior high isolates underreaction from conventional momentum
signal: return from rolling high to current session close
material_novelty: decomposes the momentum path around its intervening high
falsification_rule: Reject if the family is not positive in at least two outer folds after costs

mechanism: average return differs structurally by recurring intraday clock bucket
signal: causal rolling mean return for the same product and session bucket
material_novelty: the clock bucket forecast is the signal rather than a filter
falsification_rule: Reject if clock-bucket drift is unstable across outer folds or concentrated in one product

mechanism: discontinuous price shocks induce a distinct continuation or overreaction response
material_novelty: separates jump variation from continuous volatility
falsification_rule: Reject if jump-conditioned returns are not positive in at least two outer folds after costs

mechanism: high price impact identifies liquidity-demand shocks that should partially reverse
signal: signed return scaled by lagged dollar-volume liquidity
material_novelty: tests price impact and liquidity provision rather than participation confirmation
falsification_rule: Reject if it fails zero-cost or 3.5-bps walk-forward expectancy

mechanism: low sign-sequence entropy identifies locally persistent information flow
signal: rolling Shannon entropy of return signs interacted with recent direction
material_novelty: uses model-free sequence predictability rather than path slope
falsification_rule: Reject if entropy conditioning does not improve out-of-fold expectancy over unconditional direction
